description: Utility class for handling ContentInfo objects, including partitioning content based on a predicate and collecting URIs from ClipData.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods for content partitioning and URI collection.

methods.name: partition
methods.description: Partitions ContentInfo into accepted and remaining parts based on a predicate applied to ClipData items.

methods.name: buildClipData
methods.description: Builds a ClipData object from a description and a list of items.

methods.name: collectUris
methods.description: Collects all non-null URIs from a ClipData object.
